title: Super Palindromes
description: Find palindromes in range [left, right] whose square roots are also palindromes.
pseudocode:
1. generate palindromes p up to sqrt(right)
2. square p to get candidate
3. check if candidate is palindrome and in range [left, right]
4. count results

steps.note: Generating square root palindromes up to sqrt(1000) approx 31.
Filtering by range [4, 1000] and checking palindrome property.
